findings.title: No regression test verifies SQL expressions remain disabled
findings.body: This security fix adds a permanent rejection path for SQL expression queries, but the PR adds no automated coverage for it. A test should assert that `QueryTypeSQL` is rejected both when `FlagSqlExpressions` is enabled and disabled, and that the legacy SQL command construction/execution path cannot create a usable command. Without this coverage, a future feature-toggle or database implementation change can inadvertently re-enable the RCE/LFI-prone behavior without being caught by CI.
